sentences.c: 归去来兮，田园将芜胡不归？
sentences.m: 回去吧！田园快要荒芜了，为什么还不回去？
sentences.e: Let me go home! The fields and garden are nearly overgrown — why not go back?

sentences.c: 既自以心为形役，奚惆怅而独悲？
sentences.m: 既然自己让心灵被形体所驱使，为什么还惆怅、独自悲伤？
sentences.e: Since I let my mind be enslaved by my body, why should I grieve alone?

sentences.c: 悟已往之不谏，知来者之可追。
sentences.m: 我明白过去的事已无法挽回，知道将来的事还可以补救。
sentences.e: I see that what is past cannot be recalled, but I know the future may still be mended.

sentences.c: 实迷途其未远，觉今是而昨非。
sentences.m: 其实走上迷途还不算远，已经觉悟到今天是对的、昨天是错的。
sentences.e: Truly I have not wandered far astray; I see that today is right and yesterday was wrong.

sentences.c: 舟遥遥以轻飏，风飘飘而吹衣。
sentences.m: 船在水上远远地轻轻飘荡，风飘飘地吹动着衣裳。
sentences.e: The boat drifts light and far, and the wind flutters through my clothes.

sentences.c: 问征夫以前路，恨晨光之熹微。
sentences.m: 向行人打听前面的路，只恨早晨的天色还太微明。
sentences.e: I ask a traveller about the road ahead, resenting how faint the morning light still is.

sentences.c: 乃瞻衡宇，载欣载奔。
sentences.m: 终于望见了自家简陋的房屋，一边欣喜一边奔跑。
sentences.e: At last I catch sight of my humble house, and I run toward it, glad at heart.

sentences.c: 僮仆欢迎，稚子候门。
sentences.m: 仆人们前来迎接，孩子们在门口等候。
sentences.e: The servants come out to welcome me, and my young children wait at the gate.

sentences.c: 三径就荒，松菊犹存。
sentences.m: 院子里的小路快要荒芜了，松树和菊花还依然生长。
sentences.e: The paths in the yard have grown nearly wild, yet the pines and chrysanthemums still stand.

sentences.c: 携幼入室，有酒盈樽。
sentences.m: 牵着孩子走进屋，酒已装满酒樽。
sentences.e: I lead the children inside, where the wine jar is full.

sentences.c: 引壶觞以自酌，眄庭柯以怡颜。
sentences.m: 拿起酒壶酒杯自斟自饮，斜看着院中的树枝，脸上露出愉悦的神色。
sentences.e: I take up the pot and cup and pour for myself, glancing at the trees in the yard with a pleased face.

sentences.c: 倚南窗以寄傲，审容膝之易安。
sentences.m: 靠着南窗寄托傲然自得的情怀，深知狭小的居室反而容易安适。
sentences.e: Leaning on the south window I give my pride its rest, knowing how easily a room just big enough for the knees can set one at ease.

sentences.c: 园日涉以成趣，门虽设而常关。
sentences.m: 每天到园中散步已成乐趣，门虽然设着却常常关着。
sentences.e: Daily walks in the garden have become a pleasure, and though there is a gate, it stays shut.

sentences.c: 策扶老以流憩，时矫首而遐观。
sentences.m: 拄着拐杖随处走走歇歇，不时抬起头向远处眺望。
sentences.e: With a staff I wander and rest as I please, now and then lifting my head to gaze far off.

sentences.c: 云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还。
sentences.m: 云气自然而然地飘出山峦，鸟儿飞倦了也知道回巢。
sentences.e: The clouds drift out from the peaks without intent, and birds, tired of flying, know to return.

sentences.c: 景翳翳以将入，抚孤松而盘桓。
sentences.m: 日光暗淡下来，太阳快要落山，我抚摸着孤松徘徊不去。
sentences.e: The light dims as the sun goes down, and I linger, stroking the lone pine.

sentences.c: 归去来兮，请息交以绝游。
sentences.m: 回去吧！让我断绝与世俗的交游。
sentences.e: Let me go home! I would cut off all dealings and wanderings with the world.

sentences.c: 世与我而相违，复驾言兮焉求？
sentences.m: 世俗与我心意相违，还驾车出去追求什么呢？
sentences.e: The world and I are at odds — why drive out again, and for what?

sentences.c: 悦亲戚之情话，乐琴书以消忧。
sentences.m: 以亲戚间知心的话为喜悦，以弹琴读书来消解忧愁。
sentences.e: I delight in heartfelt talk with kin, and take joy in lute and books to dispel care.

sentences.c: 农人告余以春及，将有事于西畴。
sentences.m: 农人告诉我春天到了，将要到西边的田里去耕作。
sentences.e: The farmers tell me spring has come, and there will be work in the western fields.

sentences.c: 或命巾车，或棹孤舟。
sentences.m: 有时驾着有布篷的小车，有时划着一叶孤舟。
sentences.e: Sometimes I have a curtained cart made ready, sometimes I row a lone boat.

sentences.c: 既窈窕以寻壑，亦崎岖而经丘。
sentences.m: 既沿着幽深曲折的溪水探寻山谷，也经过崎岖不平的山丘。
sentences.e: Now I follow winding depths to find a ravine, now I cross the hills by rugged paths.

sentences.c: 木欣欣以向荣，泉涓涓而始流。
sentences.m: 树木欣欣向荣地生长，泉水细细地开始流淌。
sentences.e: The trees grow lush and flourishing, and the springs begin to trickle forth.

sentences.c: 善万物之得时，感吾生之行休。
sentences.m: 羡慕万物恰逢生长的时节，感叹我的一生将要结束。
sentences.e: I admire how all things meet their season, and sigh that my own life is drawing to its close.

sentences.c: 已矣乎！寓形宇内复几时？
sentences.m: 算了吧！寄身于天地之间还能有多少时光？
sentences.e: Enough! How much longer can this body lodge within the world?

sentences.c: 曷不委心任去留？
sentences.m: 为什么不随心所欲，任随生死去留？
sentences.e: Why not let the heart go free and leave going and staying to fate?

sentences.c: 胡为乎遑遑欲何之？
sentences.m: 为什么惶惶不安，想到哪里去呢？
sentences.e: Why hurry and fret — and where is it you would go?

sentences.c: 富贵非吾愿，帝乡不可期。
sentences.m: 富贵不是我的愿望，仙境也不可期望。
sentences.e: Wealth and rank are not what I wish for, and the realm of the immortals cannot be hoped for.

sentences.c: 怀良辰以孤往，或植杖而耘耔。
sentences.m: 趁着美好的时光独自出游，有时把拐杖插在田边去锄草培土。
sentences.e: I cherish the fine days and go out alone, or plant my staff in the field and weed and earth the crops.

sentences.c: 登东皋以舒啸，临清流而赋诗。
sentences.m: 登上东边的高地放声长啸，面对清澈的溪流吟咏诗篇。
sentences.e: I climb the eastern ridge and let out a long whistle, and face the clear stream to write my poems.

sentences.c: 聊乘化以归尽，乐夫天命复奚疑！
sentences.m: 姑且顺随自然的变化走到生命尽头，乐天知命，还有什么可犹疑的呢！
sentences.e: I will ride the changes of nature to my end; rejoicing in the will of Heaven, what is there left to doubt!
